note: An intermediate agility warm-up (part 3), the author's pattern Do Re Do Mi Do Fa Do Sol, then down by step to Do, as a run (RUN_STAGES out-from-do, the second); also sung on /learn/pitch-matching-exercises.

exercise.title: Agility: Do between each step
exercise.why: Do comes back between the notes as they climb, so each jump out from Do is a step wider than the last, and the walk back down from Sol lands you home by step.

cells.text:
Press Play below to hear the run: the mic starts with it. Sing along on the note names: {{1}} {{2}} {{1}} {{3}} {{1}} {{4}} {{1}} {{5}}, then walk back down {{4}} {{3}} {{2}} to {{1}}.
Each pass starts a semitone higher. Change to "oo" when the run gets high.
_Don't reach for high notes: let a pass go when its top stops feeling easy._
